data.title: Will Democrats sweep the 2026 U.S. Midterm Elections?
data.description:
## **Market Dates:**

- **Market Period:** From the publication date until November 3, 2026 at 1:00 AM UTC.
- **Market Close:** November 3, 2026 at 1:00 AM UTC.
- **Resolution Time:** The outcome will be determined after Market Close, once the 2026 US Midterm Elections results are officially confirmed by the market resolution sources.

## **Resolution Criteria:**

- Resolves to **“Yes”** if the Democratic Party controls **both the U.S. House of Representatives and the U.S. Senate** following the 2026 United States midterm elections.
- Resolves to **“No”** if the Democratic Party does not control both chambers after the elections.

## **Resolution Criteria:**

- For the purposes of this market, a “Democratic sweep” means the Democratic Party controls both the U.S. House of Representatives and the U.S. Senate following the election.
- A party will be considered to have control of the House of Representatives if it wins a majority of voting seats.
- A party will be considered to have control of the Senate if it holds:
  - More than half of the voting Senate seats, or
  - Half of the seats plus the Vice President, who can cast tie-breaking votes.
- A candidate’s party affiliation will be determined by their ballot-listed or otherwise identifiable affiliation at the time the election results are conclusively called by the resolution sources.
- Candidates without a ballot-listed affiliation to either the Democratic or Republican Parties will be considered aligned with the party they most recently expressed intent to caucus with at the time results are finalized.
- If control of the House remains ambiguous, the market will resolve according to the party affiliation of the first Speaker of the U.S. House selected following the 2026 midterm elections.
- If control of the Senate remains ambiguous, the market will resolve according to the party affiliation of the first Senate Majority Leader selected following the elections.

## **Resolution Details:**

- This market will resolve once all the following sources have conclusively called winners determining control of the House and Senate.
  - [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/)
  - [Associated Press](https://apnews.com/)
  - [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/)
- If the three sources **do not reach consensus**, this market will resolve according to the **official certification of election results**.

## **Cancellation (Invalidity) Conditions**

- The 2026 U.S. midterm elections are not held.
- Determining control of Congress becomes impossible due to extraordinary circumstances preventing certification or recognition of results.
- Myriad Markets undergoes a major technical or contractual change requiring cancellation of active markets.

If canceled, participants may claim their stakes at the market value of their open positions at the time of cancellation.

data.title: Which movie will have the biggest opening weekend of 2026?
data.description:
### **Market Dates:**

- **Market Period:** From the publication date through December 31, 2026, at 11:59 PM ET.
- **Market Close:** December 31, 2026, at 11:59 PM ET.
- **Resolution Time:** Once final 3-day opening weekend figures are published for all relevant 2026 releases, expected shortly after January 1, 2027.

### **Resolution Criteria:**

- Resolves to "Yes" for the film that grosses more on its 3-day domestic opening weekend than any other movie released in 2026, provided it is listed as an outcome in this market.
- Resolves to "No" for all other listed films.
- Resolution is based specifically on the 3-day opening weekend figure (Friday, Saturday, Sunday), regardless of whether a film has a 4- or 5-day opening weekend.
- The figures used are those reported by The Numbers under "Weekend Box Office Performance," regardless of whether "domestic" refers to the US only, or to the US and Canada combined.
- If another film's opening weekend surpasses that of a listed film after figures for both are finalized, the affected outcome may immediately resolve to "No".
- In the event of an exact tie, the film whose title comes first alphabetically will be declared the winner.

### **Resolution Details:**

- This market will be resolved using the "Weekend Box Office Performance" figures published on each film's page at [https://www.the-numbers.com/movies/year/2026](https://www.the-numbers.com/movies/year/2026), once those figures are final (i.e., not studio estimates).
- If no final data is available by January 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, another credible resolution source will be chosen.

### **Cancellation Conditions:**

- The resolution source is compromised or unavailable for prolonged periods.
- Any circumstance makes it impossible to determine the outcome definitively.

If the market is cancelled, participants may claim their stakes at the market value of their open positions at the time of cancellation. This could result in a profit or a loss, depending on the price of their outstanding shares.

data.title: FED’s interest rate decision in October?
data.description:
### **Market Dates:**

- **Market Period**: From the publication date through October 28, 2026, at 11:59 PM UTC.
- **Market Close:** October 28, 2026, at 11:59 PM UTC.
- **Resolution Deadline:** The resolution will be determined after the outcome is announced.

### **Resolution Criteria:**

- This market will resolve according to the amount of basis points by which the upper bound of the target federal funds rate changes relative to the level in place before the Federal Reserve’s October 2026 meeting. For example, if the FED decides to keep rates the same, this market will resolve “**Yes**” for “**No change**” and **“No”** for all other listed options.

### **Resolution Details:**

- This market will resolve based on the official FOMC statement released following its October 27-28, 2026 meeting. If no statement is released before the end date of the subsequent scheduled meeting, the market will resolve to “Yes” for the “No change” bracket.
- If the target federal funds rate is adjusted to a level not represented by the listed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 basis points and resolved to the corresponding bracket. For example, a 12.5 bps increase or decrease will be treated as a 25 bps change.

### **Cancellation Conditions:**

- The resolution source is suspended, becomes unreliable, or experiences significant disruptions during the Market Period.

If cancelled, participants may claim their stakes at the then-current market value of their shares, which could result in a profit or a loss depending on their open positions.

data.title: ETH at three digits when Bitcoin goes below 50K?
data.description:
### **Market Details:**

- **Market Close:** This market will only be closed once a resolution is achieved.
- **Resolution Deadline:** The resolution will be determined as soon as an outcome is reached.
- **Observation Period:** From the minute candle the Conditional BTC Target is hit on the resolution source until exactly 48 hours later.
- **Resolution Time:** 48 hours after the Conditional BTC Target is met or before during the Observation Period if the ETH Market Target is reached.
- **Conditional BTC Target:** $50,000.00
- **ETH Market Target**: $999.99

### **Resolution Criteria:**

- The market resolves to “**Yes**” if ETH/USDT is at or below the ETH Market Target at any point during the Observation Period.
- The market resolves to “**No**” if ETH/USD is above the ETH Market Target during the entire Observation Period.

### **Resolution Details:**

The market resolves based on the Binance ETH/USDT and BTC/USDT spot price, using the 1-minute chart with the following specifications:

- 1-minute timeframe ("1m").
- Trading View.
- "Close" price of each candle.

Only the price of ETH/USDT and BTC/USDT as quoted by Binance (spot market) will be considered.

- The Observation Period will start at the exact 1-minute candle that the Conditional BTC Target was hit and last until exactly 48 hours later. For example, if the Conditional BTC Target is hit on March 31, 2026 at 11:32 PM UTC, all 1-minute candles until April 2, 2026 at 11:32 (including the last candle) will be subject to this markets resolution.
- The ETH Market Target being hit outside of the Observation Period will not have any influence on the resolution of this market.

### **Cancellation (Invalidity) Conditions:**

- The BTC/USDT or ETH/USDT spot market on Binance is suspended or becomes unreliable.
- The Binance platform is unavailable or experiences significant disruptions.
- Any circumstance prevents reliable price tracking.
- Myriad Markets undergoes a change in its contract that demands a cancellation of all active markets, or a similar significant technical change.
- Myriad Markets decides it is time for this market to cease to exist.

In the event of cancellation, participants may claim their stakes at the market value of their open positions at the time of cancellation. This could result in a profit or a loss, depending on the price of their outstanding shares.
